IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE' and table_schema = 'D360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE;
END;

CREATE TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE]
( 
	[H]	[varchar](50)	NULL,
	[CORP_ID] [VARCHAR](32)  NULL,
	[DEL] [numeric](1,0)  NULL,
	[FUNC_ID] [VARCHAR](32)  NULL,
	[ID] [VARCHAR](32)  NULL,
	[REF_NO] [VARCHAR](32)  NULL,
	[STATUS] [int]  NULL,
	[VERSION] [int]  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime2](7)  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	HEAP
)
GO




IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE_SELECT_SRC' and table_schema = 'd360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE_SELECT_SRC;
END;

CREATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE_SELECT_SRC
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN)
AS
SELECT 			 TOP 1
				 [CORP_ID]
				,[DEL]
				,[FUNC_ID]
				,[ID]
				,[REF_NO]
				,[STATUS]
				,[VERSION]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,1 AS JSRC_FLG 
				,0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE]
            WHERE H = 'D' AND 1=2;
			
IF EXISTS(SELECT table_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.tables where table_name = 'STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE_GROUP_SRC' and table_schema = 'd360')
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE_GROUP_SRC;
END;

CREATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE_GROUP_SRC
WITH (HEAP, DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN)
AS
select 			 TOP 1
				 [CORP_ID]
				,[DEL]
				,[FUNC_ID]
				,[ID]
				,[REF_NO]
				,[STATUS]
				,[VERSION]
				,[FILE_NAME]
				,JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,JTAR_FLG_CNT
				,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
				 [CORP_ID]
				,[DEL]
				,[FUNC_ID]
				,[ID]
				,[REF_NO]
				,[STATUS]
				,[VERSION]
				,MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME 
				,SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT 
				,SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE_SELECT_SRC
	WHERE 1=2
	GROUP BY     [CORP_ID]
				,[DEL]
				,[FUNC_ID]
				,[ID]
				,[REF_NO]
				,[STATUS]
				,[VERSION]
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP



CREATE TABLE [EDS].[BOB_TBLCORPSERVICE]
( 
	[CORP_ID] [VARCHAR](32)  NULL,
	[DEL] [numeric](1,0)  NULL,
	[FUNC_ID] [VARCHAR](32)  NULL,
	[ID] [VARCHAR](32)  NULL,
	[REF_NO] [VARCHAR](32)  NULL,
	[STATUS] [int]  NULL,
	[VERSION] [int]  NULL,
	[SCD_Start_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[SCD_End_Date] [date]  NULL,
	[isActive] [int]  NULL,
	[isLatest] [int]  NULL,
	[BNK_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[SOURCE_CODE] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FILE_NAME] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[insert_dttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
 DISTRIBUTION = HASH(ID),
 HEAP
)
GO
